findings.evidence: grep for `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero|apply_p_eq_zero` over `code/` returns hits only inside ParityOdd.lean itself: 171,188,197,205,213,220,227,233 plus the internal uses at 193,201,209,224,230,236. `apply_p_eq_zero_of_spectator` in Tensors/Basic.lean:883 is an unrelated statement about `g`.
findings.fix: Keep the `_of_spectatorPlane` four (the route the headline theorems `eq_div_smul`/`existsUnique_sub_flip_eq_smul` already take via `apply_eq_mul_apply_e₁_e₂`) and delete the four `SpectatorPartners` variants; drop the corresponding bullets in the module docstring (lines 55–62).
findings.issue: Parallel API: `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero`, `apply_p_eq_zero`, `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero_right`, `apply_p_eq_zero_right` (lines 171–209, hypothesis `SpectatorPartners`) state exactly the same four conclusions as `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero_of_spectatorPlane`, `apply_p_eq_zero_of_spectatorPlane`, `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero_right_of_spectatorPlane`, `apply_p_eq_zero_right_of_spectatorPlane` (lines 213–236). Neither family has any consumer in the repository, and the only instance exhibited for either hypothesis is `spectatorPlaneFour`.

findings.evidence: `SpectatorPlane.spectatorPartners` sets `toSpectatorSplitting := hP.toSpectatorSplitting` (Basic.lean:1126) and `partner u ... := ⟨hnull u huq huT hu, _⟩` (1128), so both projections used at ParityOdd.lean:489–490 reduce to `spectatorPlaneFour.toSpectatorSplitting` and `gFour_self_ne_zero_of_spectator` (ParityOdd.lean:461, 482–483); `eq_zero_of_isLorentzCovariant` (ParityOdd.lean:282) takes `SpectatorSplitting g K` plus `hnull`, never `SpectatorPartners`.
findings.fix: In `not_isLorentzCovariant_aFour` pass `spectatorPlaneFour.toSpectatorSplitting` and `fun _ hq hT hu => gFour_self_ne_zero_of_spectator hq hT hu` directly to `eq_zero_of_isLorentzCovariant` (which takes `SpectatorSplitting` + the non-nullity hypothesis, not `SpectatorPartners`), then delete `SpectatorPartners`, `SpectatorPartners.self_ne_zero_of_spectator`, `SpectatorPlane.spectatorPartners` and `spectatorPartners_kFour`, and the `SpectatorPartners` mentions in the Basic.lean module doc (line 26) and ParityOdd.lean doc (lines 41,56–59,71).
findings.issue: Scaffolding with no real consumer: `SpectatorPartners` (1097), `SpectatorPartners.self_ne_zero_of_spectator` (1105) and the 34-line `SpectatorPlane.spectatorPartners` (1122–1155) are used only by the duplicate lemma family above and by `Witness.spectatorPartners_kFour` (ParityOdd.lean:481). At that sole use site, `not_isLorentzCovariant_aFour` (ParityOdd.lean:487–490) projects out `spectatorPartners_kFour.toSpectatorSplitting` and `.self_ne_zero_of_spectator`, which are by construction the two arguments fed into `SpectatorPlane.spectatorPartners` in the first place.

summary: The parity-odd mathematics is new and reuses `AlternatingMap.bilinMap`, `LinearMap.transvection.det` and `Matrix.toBilin'` properly, but the PR ships the same four annihilation facts twice (under `SpectatorPartners` and under `SpectatorPlane`) with no consumer for either, and the whole `SpectatorPartners` track exists only to feed them plus one call site that already has its two inputs.
